title: The Refractive Engine
description: Frontend engineering as an optical lens: a latent particle field that snaps into a page layout wherever the cursor looks, with eight projects as glass prisms that split into their real layers.
signature: One Points draw of up to 100k particles positioned in the vertex shader; a screen-space cursor lens snaps them onto a UI wireframe with a chromatic ring in post, and every HUD number is read from the live renderer.
